decisions.reason: The source refines the left and right arms of the Hero V, not the separate E and L letterforms, which remain deferred and unchanged.
The requirement that the second V derive from the Hero V geometry remains valid unchanged; the source does not establish a separate modification to the second V.
The É accent's required derivation from the Hero V remains unchanged, and the source does not specify a new accent construction or correspondence rule.
The source addresses internal Hero V geometry rather than wordmark spacing or kerning, which remains deferred.
Selecting and refining a Hero V geometry family does not change the deferred champagne-metal material direction or its application constraint.
The source's reference to Option 2 concerns design selection and has no effect on required review-image file formats.
